name: run_draft_tool
description: Execute a tool-under-construction once and return what happened. Used by the tool_builder agent loop after write_tool_files. Builds (or reuses) the tool's venv, runs `python tool.py` with `args` as stdin JSON, and returns exit code + stdout + stderr. This is the 'run it and analyze the result' step: read the returned stdout/stderr, compare against the spec's acceptance criteria, and if it's wrong, fix tool.py and call write_tool_files + run_draft_tool again. Secrets the tool declares in _meta.allowed_secrets are injected automatically when set in the vault.

tool_name.description: Snake_case name of the draft tool (must already be written via write_tool_files).

args.description: Sample input passed to the tool as stdin JSON. Use a realistic value from the spec's Inputs / acceptance criteria.
